message: 押しが強い人種

name: Nanaka
message: 「Okay, approved!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, since things are mostly settled, let's head over to Helena-san's...」

name: Jangara
message: 「Ee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Here, chocolate」

name: Sally
message: 「No fair, Jangara. I want chocolate too!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then you help out with something too」

name: Sally
message: 「I won't help, I just want chocolate, gimme gimme!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Tagalong-san. He who does not work--or monkey around--shall not eat」

name: Sally
message: 「I wanna eat even if I don't work!」

name: Ria
message: 「Then I'll give you this kashiwa mochi」

name: Sally
message: 「Yay」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ah, wait, since monkeys don't work, wouldn't everyone starve to death? That's a rather strange proverb, isn't it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Big trouble, big trouble, biiig trouble」

name: Misa
message: 「Takahashi-san! Running in the hallway is----」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Don't sweat the small stuff like that. Synn-kun, it's big trouble!」

name: Synn
message: 「I get that it's big trouble, so」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm sure it's no big deal」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Listen, listen. Ryo-chan collapsed with the mumps」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat!? I knew she left early, but...」

name: Misa
message: 「Ryo-chan?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Otomo Ryoko. Our class's Kirafes executive committee member」

name: Ria
message: 「She hadn't gotten the mumps until this age... That's rough」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She said she felt feverish, so she stopped by the doctor on the way home and got that diagnosis~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...So she can't make it on the day of?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nope, she can't~ Ahh, now I'm the only executive committee member left, I'm gonna be swamped~」

name: Misa
message: 「To think the less competent one is the one left behind...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Even a withered tree adds to the liveliness of the mountain, as they say」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're always casually harsh, aren't you」

name: Sacchin
message: 「What's with those eyes looking at me like I'm some pitiful kid!? My feelings are hurt~ Hmph!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe we can find a replacement... no, that's probably impossible」

name: Sally
message: 「Me, me!」

name: Misa
message: 「I doubt we can」

name: Synn
message: 「Plenty of kids are willing to just help out, sure, but being on the executive committee comes with a lot of responsibility. There's a ton to do on the actual day, too」

name: Sally
message: 「I don't really get what's going on, but I'll help!」

name: Misa
message: 「It is precisely because there is responsibility that one should take the initiative and step up!」

name: Ria
message: 「It's impossible to expect that from everyone」

name: Sally
message: 「Am I being ignored here!?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Because you're just an extra, after all」

name: Sally
message: 「Gasp」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, that means we can at least find someone to cover her prep work up until the day before, right? What was Otomo-san doing? Huh, where'd Sacchin go?」

name: Misa
message: 「Did she run away?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why is she only fast when it comes to stuff like this...」

name: Sally
message: 「Well, I mean, I don't wanna do anything tiring either, you know」

name: Ria
message: 「Otomo-san's duties up through the day before were setting up the reception desk and decorating the main gate. It's pretty heavy labor」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it's gonna be rough if we don't find a fill-in」

name: Misa
message: 「Nanaka-san, sorry to trouble you, but could I ask for your help again?」

name: Synn
message: 「Again?」

name: Misa
message: 「We have someone acting as a rover for us」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hold on, let me ask」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, Yumil. How are things on your end? Good, good, going smoothly? Dependable as ever, I see」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So, sorry to bother you, but could you help set up the reception desk and decorate the main gate? Yeah, yeah. Of course I haven't forgotten, see you later」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She says okay」

name: Sally
message: 「Congrats! Guess I didn't even need to sortie!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey」

name: Misa
message: 「What?」

name: Synn
message: 「Why not just have her become an executive committee member」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She says she'd never do it because she wouldn't get to eat sweets on the day of the event」

name: Synn
message: 「...Sigh」

name: Ria
message: 「Nuh-uh. Sighing won't move things forward, you know~」

name: Synn
message: 「True... Otomo-san probably won't be able to make it on the day. Do you know anyone, Lolotte?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hehehe. I figured you'd ask that, so I secretly did some research beforehand」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Skip the preamble」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Treasurer-san. You're jealous of my competence, aren't you. Too bad, though. I won't hand over my position as secretary!」

name: Misa
message: 「Otomo-san is in charge of records」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Aah. That's my line!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Records, huh... Wouldn't that be fine then? The photography club is already documenting things on their own, and there are two other people on records」

name: Misa
message: 「Why were there three people on records in the first place」

name: Ria
message: 「Come to think of it, why? It's always been like that, so I never really thought about it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Isn't it because the Student Council has three digital cameras as equipment?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm pretty sure you've got that backwards」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I caught one for you~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「He was just wandering around, so I went 'heave-ho!' Praise me, praise me~」
So Azel is weak against pushy people who go at their own pace, huh.
Sacchin doesn't listen to what people say without batting an eye, after all.

name: Synn
message: 「Azel. Could you serve on the executive committee, even if it's just on the day of KiraFes?」

name: Azel
message: 「What is an executive committee」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Starting from the basics!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's okay if you don't understand that stuff~ Even I don't really get it~」

name: Azel
message: 「Is that so」

name: Misa
message: 「Please understand it!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hey, hey. Ryo-chan is working as the caramel-man on the day of, right~」

name: Misa
message: 「Caramel...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What kind of shop is that」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh~ Isn't that it~? He's not in charge of stirring caramel~?」

name: Synn
message: 「He's in charge of recording how KiraFes goes」

name: Sacchin
message: 「That just means wandering around randomly with a digicam on the day of, right~」

name: Ria
message: 「I don't think... it's quite that easy\s02」

name: Azel
message: 「Digi, cam...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「So anyway, Azel-chan. It's a suuuper easy role, so you don't need to think too deeply about it~」

name: Azel
message: 「...It's pointless」

name: Sacchin
message: 「We just need to fill the headcount, so it's fine if you have no motivation. Even if one person doesn't do anything, someone else will cover for them somehow~」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't teach him irresponsible things」

name: Azel
message: 「...I don't care」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah. It's a super unimportant role, so you'll be fine just half-assing it. I totally guarantee it~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Guarantee what, exactly!」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel」

name: Synn
message: 「If you'll take on the recorder role, I'll lend you this from today until Kirafes ends.」
I placed the digital camera on top of the desk.
Azel's gaze stopped on the digital camera.

name: Synn
message: 「You can take pictures of whatever you like.」

name: Azel
message: 「Take pictures...」

name: Misa
message: 「Hold on, Sakura-kun! Taking Student Council equipment without permission--」

name: Synn
message: 「Here」
I held the digital camera out to Azel.

name: Synn
message: 「Give it back once Kirafes is over, okay?」
Azel timidly reached out his arm and took the digital camera from my hand.

name: Synn
message: 「...You can take as many pictures as you can. On the flip side, if you don't feel like taking any, you don't have to take a single one.」

name: Misa & Nanaka
message: 「Whaaaaat?!」

name: Misa
message: 「What are you thinking!」

name: Azel
message: 「...I won't take any」

name: Synn
message: 「That's fine too. Anyway, it's in your hands now. Don't lose it, okay?」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte. Update the recorder spot for me.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「...Understood.」

name: Azel
message: 「Is it really... okay no matter what I take pictures of?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Anything at all, as long as it's something you want to photograph, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm not gonna take any, you hear me?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's fine too.」
Azel left the Student Council room without saying a word.

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're amazing, Synn-kun~. At least on paper, we've filled the recorder spot~. Just like a government office~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's not something to be impressed by... Are you sure about this?」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm sure」

name: Misa
message: 「True... Unlike Sally-san, she doesn't seem like the type to run off with it, though」

name: Sally
message: 「That's casually unfair! I might swap it out, but I wouldn't run off with it!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Indeed, even a withered tree adds liveliness to the mountain」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. You have some kind of plan, don't you?」

name: Synn
message: 「It's not really much of a plan... I just got the feeling that Azel wanted to take photos」

name: Misa
message: 「What's that supposed to mean!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see... Then it might just work out♪」
Saying that, Ria-senpai smiled gently.
